component.name: Marupo
component.summary: Pure Rust Markdown to PDF and HTML converter
純Rust製 Markdown to PDF / HTML 変換アプリ

description.p: Marupo is a standalone desktop application written in pure Rust that parses Markdown, typesets pages with system fonts, renders a live page-sheet preview, and exports vector PDFs and self-contained HTML without relying on WebView, Chromium, or LaTeX.
Marupo（マルポ）は、WebViewや外部変換ツール（LaTeX・Chromium等）に依存せず、 100%純粋なRustコードのみでMarkdownの解析・組版・リアルタイムプレビュー・ベクターPDF/単一HTML出力を行うデスクトップアプリです。

ul.li: 100% matching live continuous page preview and vector PDF output
YAML Frontmatter, auto TOC, GitHub-style Callouts, highlights (==text==), and 2D LaTeX math
Customizable emphasis styles, JSON/CSS theme live editing, and CLI export mode

description.p: Improved YAML frontmatter header card layout, added H2 page break option, and updated default emphasis and code styles.
Added Linux desktop and Flatpak support alongside Windows portable build.
